4c96d4f2462e381b.description: Jasara Program Management Company (Jasara PMC) is a leading Joint Venture between Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco, established to deliver world-class program management services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Jasara plays a key role in supporting the realization of Saudi Vision 2030, particularly in delivering giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments. We are seeking a Senior Structural Design Manager to join JASARA PMC. This role will lead and manage the structural design delivery of large-scale residential developments, ensuring designs meet project objectives, regulatory requirements, quality standards, budget constraints, and construction timelines. The role will oversee consultants, coordinate multidisciplinary design teams, and support the successful execution of residential communities within the project. Key Responsibilities Lead the structural design development for residential projects from concept through detailed design and construction support. Manage and review the work of external design consultants and engineering partners. Ensure compliance with Saudi Building Code, international design standards, and project-specific requirements. Coordinate structural design activities with architecture, MEP, infrastructure, and other disciplines. Review and approve structural calculations, drawings, specifications, and technical submissions. Identify design risks and implement mitigation measures to support project delivery. Monitor design progress against project schedules and budgets. Provide technical leadership and guidance to project teams and junior engineers. Support value engineering initiatives without compromising quality, safety, or performance. Participate in design reviews, workshops, stakeholder meetings, and technical presentations. Provide construction-phase support, including RFI responses, design clarifications, and site issue resolution. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering (Master's degree preferred). Professional Engineering registration or chartership preferred (PE, CEng, ICE, or equivalent). Minimum 15 years of experience in structural design and engineering. At least 5 years in a leadership or managerial role overseeing large residential or mixed-use developments. Strong experience with reinforced concrete, steel structures, high-rise residential buildings, and residential communities. Experience working with major developers, engineering consultancies, or giga projects is highly desirable. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of structural design software such as ETABS, SAFE, SAP2000, STAAD Pro, and similar tools. Thorough understanding of Saudi and international design codes and standards. Experience managing multidisciplinary design coordination. Excellent stakeholder management and consultant management skills. Strong commercial awareness and value engineering experience. Preferred Experience Large-scale residential master-planned communities. Mega and giga projects in Saudi Arabia or the GCC. Design management within developer organizations. Experience interfacing with authorities and regulatory bodies.

Apply now and be part of a future-focused organization shaping tomorrow’s success. The role supports inspection planning, field activities, compliance follow-up, reporting, and continuous improvement of inspection performance. Key Accountabilities: Support technical inspection activities related to exploitation licenses, ensuring safe and effective inspections. Develop operational work plans to ensure appropriate inspection coverage across exploitation licenses. Manage weekly inspection schedules and team deployment to achieve coverage targets while considering fatigue management. Conduct and support field inspections. Review periodic exploitation inspection reports and verify compliance with Mining Law and Regulations. Follow up on identified non-compliance cases and required actions. Support continuous improvement of inspection team performance and provide on-the-job support to team members and new employees. Support relevant requests from government stakeholders and internal departments. Develop dashboards and reports covering exploitation inspection activities and performance. Minimum Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in mining engineering, geology, or related field. Minimum 6 years of experience in similar position.

Ensuring compliance with all aviation regulations, company policies, and operational procedures. Maintaining a high level of situational awareness and decision-making during all phases of flight. 4c1681e12eccf944.description: About the Role Jazera Arabia Contracting is seeking an experienced Health Safety Environment Engineer (HSE Engineer) to manage health, safety, and environmental activities for road and bridge construction projects. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and Afif, Saudi Arabia, and requires a strong background in the construction sector. Role Overview The HSE Engineer will be responsible for overseeing all health, safety, and environmental aspects across multiple construction sites. This is a fully field-based role, requiring regular presence on site to ensure compliance and maintain a safe working environment for all project teams. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular site inspections to identify potential hazards and ensure adherence to safety protocols. Perform risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for construction activities. Monitor safety performance and implement corrective actions as needed. Investigate incidents, accidents, and near-misses, and prepare detailed reports. Coordinate with project teams to integrate health, safety, and environmental considerations into project planning and execution. Ensure compliance with all relevant health, safety, and environmental regulations and company policies. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience as an HSE Engineer. Proven experience in road and bridge construction projects is essential. Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental regulations and best practices. Work Environment This role operates in a dynamic construction environment across various sites in Riyadh and Afif. The position requires a proactive approach to safety management and continuous engagement with on-site teams. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are invited to apply for this full-time position with Jazera Arabia Contracting. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4c1ba33ce6c7fd95.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Heart of the House professional for a full-time position in Jeddah. This role is responsible for maintaining cleanliness and order across public and employee areas, ensuring a high standard of presentation and hygiene within the property. Key Responsibilities Clean public and employee restrooms, showers, and glass surfaces. Clean floor surfaces in public and employee areas using designated chemicals, supplies, and equipment. Dust assigned areas and empty trash containers, ashtrays, and ash urns into proper receptacles. Inspect furniture for tears, rips, and stains, and report any damages. Clean and maintain lights, and post caution signs as needed to limit traffic. Contact other departments directly for urgent repairs and respond promptly to requests from guests and other departments. Identify and report preventative or other maintenance issues in public areas or guest rooms. Adhere to all company safety and security policies and procedures, report maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries, and complete required safety training. Ensure a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance, and maintain confidentiality of proprietary information. Welcome and acknowledge guests according to company standards, anticipate and address service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate professionally and clearly with others. Support team efforts to achieve common goals and ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, and place objects weighing up to 55 pounds without assistance, and in excess of 55 pounds with assistance. Capability to push and pull work-related machinery over sloping and uneven surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines to identify defects. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces, and ascend/descend ladders. Stand, sit, kneel, or walk for extended periods across an entire work shift. About the Team and Culture This role is part of The Ritz-Carlton team, a brand within Marriott International, known for creating exceptional guest experiences. The team operates under the "Gold Standards," which guide daily operations and emphasize creativity, thoughtfulness, and compassion. As a member of this team, you will learn and exemplify these standards, including the Employee Promise, Credo, and Service Values, contributing to a culture that prioritizes excellence in guest care and comfort. It involves working in a dynamic hospitality environment where adherence to established service standards and teamwork are essential. The Ritz-Carlton fosters a supportive environment where employees are encouraged to develop professionally and take pride in their work. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this opportunity to join Marriott International and The Ritz-Carlton team.

4c1bc1630712bd26.description: About Tarabut Holding Limited Tarabut is a regulated open banking platform in the Middle East, holding licenses from SAMA in Saudi Arabia, CBUAE in the UAE, and CBB in Bahrain. The company connects banks, lenders, and fintechs to financial data and payments infrastructure, while also developing embedded finance distribution across the region, including an SME lending business in Saudi Arabia. Role Overview: Project Manager, Bank Programmes Tarabut is seeking a Project Manager to oversee bank programmes within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing two to three key programmes concurrently, collaborating with tier-1 Saudi banks to facilitate rapid product deployment. The Project Manager will engage with stakeholders from the C-suite to integration managers, manage client relationships, and work with product and commercial teams to expand these accounts. This position is based in Ar Riyad (Riyadh) and reports to the Chief Strategy Officer, with regular travel required to Jeddah and Bahrain. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain comprehensive programme plans, including milestones, dependencies, decisions, and risks. Serve as the primary point of contact for bank counterparties, owning client relationships. Organize and lead weekly meetings with bank counterparties, including working groups and steering committees, ensuring actions are closed. Address programme delays by investigating details and ensuring resolution. Identify opportunities for programme expansion and translate them into scoped follow-on work. Manage approval-linked milestones and go-live gates in coordination with the compliance team. Identify and escalate risks early, providing potential solutions. First 90 Days Objectives Establish one programme plan and weekly cadence, adopted by all counterparties. Successfully deliver the first inherited bank milestone on schedule. Implement a RAID log that is trusted by both internal and external teams. Qualifications and Experience 6-10 years of experience in project management. Delivery experience with banks in the GCC region. Domain experience in open banking, lending, or payments. Established relationships within GCC banks. Proficiency with AI tooling and current understanding of LLM capabilities, applying them to accelerate programme execution while discerning when human review is necessary. Experience guiding a regulated product through go-live with SAMA or CBB supervised institutions. Work Location This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires regular travel to Jeddah and Bahrain.

4c2de66d99376a61.description: About the Role AlKhalejiah is seeking a Logistics & Fleet Operations Manager to lead end-to-end logistics operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role primarily focuses on transportation, distribution, and fleet management, with additional oversight of warehousing and inventory operations. The manager will ensure reliable food logistics services through effective operational systems, cost control, resource planning, and continuous performance improvement. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation and distribution, including route planning, delivery schedules, vehicle allocation, and capacity based on demand. Oversee fleet availability, preventive maintenance, repairs, and vehicle replacement planning, while monitoring fuel consumption, mileage, downtime, and driver productivity. Manage third-party transport providers, monitoring service quality, cost, and contractual performance. Lead the effective use and improvement of ERP, TMS, WMS, and fleet tracking platforms, ensuring accurate operational data and improving workflows with Finance and IT. Prepare and manage budgets for transportation, fleet, distribution, and warehousing, analyzing costs and identifying improvement opportunities. Control fuel, maintenance, manpower, subcontractor, and warehouse operating costs, reviewing budget variances and implementing corrective actions. Ensure appropriate handling, storage, and transportation of food products, including chilled and frozen goods, maintaining temperature controls, hygiene standards, and product traceability. Oversee receiving, storage, picking, dispatch, and inventory control activities, ensuring inventory accuracy through stock counts and reconciliations. Lead transport, fleet, distribution, and warehouse teams, establishing clear responsibilities and performance targets. Monitor KPIs covering delivery timeliness, fleet utilization, operating costs, inventory accuracy, and product losses, presenting regular performance reports to management. Operational Systems and Data Management The role involves leading the effective use and improvement of critical operational systems such as ERP, Transport Management Systems (TMS), Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), and fleet tracking platforms. This includes ensuring accurate operational data across all records, collaborating with Finance, IT, and system providers to enhance workflows and reporting, and establishing dashboards for performance visibility. Training teams on system usage and enforcing consistent operational processes are also key aspects. Food Logistics and Cold Chain Management A critical component of this role is ensuring the appropriate handling, storage, and transportation of food products, including chilled and frozen goods. This involves maintaining strict temperature controls, hygiene standards, product traceability, and cold chain integrity. The manager will monitor temperature records, address deviations, and coordinate with Quality teams to uphold food safety standards throughout the storage and distribution processes. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in logistics and fleet operations management. Proven experience in managing transportation, distribution, and warehousing. Familiarity with ERP, TMS, WMS, and fleet tracking platforms. Strong understanding of cost control and operational efficiency principles. Experience in food logistics and cold chain management is essential. Demonstrated leadership and performance management skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires coordination with various internal teams, external stakeholders, and third-party providers to ensure seamless logistics operations and high service levels.

4c2ffbe0039e93e1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة وئام الحجاز للمقاولات عن فني ميكانيكي معدات ثقيلة للانضمام إلى فريقها في خليص، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على متابعة تركيب المعدات الثقيلة، تحديد القطع التبديلية وتأمينها، بالإضافة إلى فحص وتشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة عمليات الإصلاح لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة العمليات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تركيب الأجهزة والمعدات الثقيلة والإشراف على إجراءات تشغيلها. تحديد القطع التبديلية اللازمة، مطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المعدات الثقيلة المخصصة للصيانة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص أعطال المعدات بدقة ومتابعة جميع مراحل إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في المؤسسة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ميكانيكا المعدات الثقيلة أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فحص وتشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بالقطع التبديلية ومواصفاتها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة وئام الحجاز للمقاولات في منطقة خليص، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني والتعامل المباشر مع المعدات الثقيلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

4c799c3b05c38615.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية لمشاريع الأعمال الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب التقدم، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. فهم عميق لبرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية والصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة. المهارات الشخصية مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. القدرة على متابعة التطورات التقنية وتطبيقها. مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة المشاريع. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة ساس البلد للتشغيل والصيانة، يرجى التقديم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

4c7ba9eff7cd11ce.description: About the Role Premium Food Company is seeking a Projects Manager Restaurants to oversee restaurant construction and fit-out projects. 4c83e76014902550.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخليج العربي للصيانة والمقاولات عن فني هندسة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يساهم هذا الدور في دعم أنشطة الهندسة الميكانيكية، بدءًا من البحث والتصميم وصولاً إلى الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساعدة في أبحاث الهندسة الميكانيكية وتصميم المعدات والنظم. دعم أنشطة الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة للمعدات والنظم. المساهمة في تطوير نظريات جديدة وتحسين الأساليب الحالية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. تقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة ضمن عملية التصميم الشاملة. دعم المشاريع الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم. إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم في أعمال صيانة النظم وتصليحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية أو ما يعادله. فهم جيد لمبادئ الهندسة الميكانيكية وتطبيقاتها. القدرة على المساعدة في تصميم المعدات والنظم. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات والتحليل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق متعدد التخصصات. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. مهارات تواصل فعالة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم العمليات الهندسية والصيانة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

4c8de300418aac23.company_name: شركة الرواد الفنيه للتجارة والمقاولات العامة
4c8de300418aac23.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة خواص الحلول للمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بالإشراف على عمليات الصيانة وضمان كفاءة الأداء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة لإتمامها. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمل. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ النتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بأنشطة الصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي مماثل. القدرة على إدارة وتوجيه فرق العمل بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في التخطيط والتنظيم والمتابعة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام والكفاءة في تنفيذ المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق متخصص والمساهمة في عمليات الصيانة الحيوية للشركة. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم على هذا الدور، يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية مع ذكر الخبرات ذات الصلة.

4c95e85ef0aab976.description: About the Role MCG Talent is seeking a Senior Media Executive to join an independent media consultancy. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves supporting leading brands across the UAE and the wider region. The position offers a media professional the opportunity to develop strategic planning, analytical, and client-facing skills while addressing various media and business challenges. Key Responsibilities Support the development of integrated media strategies and plans across digital and traditional channels. Review media plans and recommendations, providing data-led input. Analyze campaign performance to identify opportunities for improved effectiveness and ROI. Conduct market, audience, and competitor research to inform media recommendations. Prepare client presentations, reports, and campaign reviews. Collaborate with clients and their media agencies to ensure campaign alignment with business objectives. Support media audits, campaign evaluations, and agency pitch processes. Monitor industry trends, media developments, and emerging platforms. Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure effective project delivery. Contribute to the development of strategic recommendations for clients. Required Experience and Skills 2-5 years of experience in a relevant media agency role. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Experience working with media performance data and campaign reporting. Good understanding of audience planning, media buying, and campaign optimization. Strong presentation and communication skills. Comfortable interacting directly with clients and agency partners. Commercially minded with an interest in media effectiveness and ROI. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves working within an independent media consultancy that supports a diverse portfolio of leading brands. The position requires collaboration with both internal teams and external partners, including clients and their media agencies. Application Process Candidates meeting the outlined requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4ca19c1b0bf5fa1f.description: About the Internship AWS EMEA SARL (Saudi Arabia Branch) is offering an internship for a Data Center Engineering Operations Technician in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This 3-month, full-time internship (40 hours per week) is scheduled to begin in summer 2027 and is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs. Role Overview As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern, you will gain hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure supporting Amazon's global data centers. The role involves providing technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers, ensuring mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate with 100% availability. This position requires daily on-site presence, typically Sunday through Thursday day schedules. Full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays; candidates should be prepared for this commitment upon transitioning to a full-time position. Key Responsibilities Maintain mechanical and electrical equipment. Assist with root cause analysis of equipment failures. Troubleshoot facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment. Utilize internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows. Interact with third-party vendors and contractors working on site. Equipment Exposure Interns will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers, maintaining better than **** uptime. This includes, but is not limited to: Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear. Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs). Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers. Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs). Building automation systems. Required Skills and Qualifications This internship is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Critical skills for success include prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly to situations. The role involves both independent work and team-based collaboration. About the Team The AWS Infrastructure Services team is responsible for the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure, including data centers and all supporting equipment. Interns will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers, collaborating across AWS to maintain high standards for safety and security while ensuring continuous access to services for customers.

4ccbdd9f8c542af3.company_name: Data Services Saudi Arabia Limited One Person Company - H12
4ccbdd9f8c542af3.description: About the Internship Amazon is seeking a Physical Security Specialist Intern to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, 12-week internship designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns demonstrating strong performance may be considered for a full-time Security Specialist position, subject to available roles and business needs. The role is based at a data center facility in a remote location without public transportation access, requiring a valid driving license and personal transportation for daily commute. Role Overview The Security Specialist Intern will work within the Data Center Security team at Amazon Web Services (AWS), focusing on the physical security operations of Amazon's data centers. This hands-on role involves direct engagement with people, systems, and processes to maintain critical infrastructure safety. The intern will contribute to operational security excellence, prepare reports and presentations, and communicate with management regarding physical security operations. This role does not involve cybersecurity. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with vendors involved in new security construction, repairs, daily security operations, patrols, and planning. Analyze security metrics and data to identify trends and recommend improvements. Suggest enhancements for electronic surveillance systems and access controls. Assist in developing and delivering guidance to data center occupants on reducing false alarms. Prepare reports and presentations on the status of physical security operations for management. Support the planning and coordination of security-related projects. Aid in incident documentation and follow-up processes. Qualifications and Requirements 0-1 year of experience. Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours per week) internship for 12 consecutive weeks. Availability to report to work on-site daily, typically Sunday through Thursday. Possession of a valid driving license and access to personal transportation. Work Environment and Team The intern will join the AWS Infrastructure Services team, which is responsible for the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. This diverse team includes engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, and operations managers. The role involves collaboration across AWS to maintain high standards for safety and security within data centers. Mentorship and career growth are supported through structured onboarding and experienced mentors, fostering an environment of knowledge sharing and skill development. Application Information Candidates are encouraged to consider the site location and commuting requirements before applying. Salary information for this internship is not disclosed.

4ce1a58bb6a50887.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التفاعل الذكي للاتصالات عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة في خدمة العملاء، والمشاركة في تطوير الإجراءات والبرامج التي تهدف إلى تعظيم جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء. كما يتضمن الدور تحليل نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء ورضاهم. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الأداء والجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، وضمان المتابعة المستمرة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما يشمل تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام والرد على طلباتهم واستفساراتهم بفعالية وكفاءة ومهنية، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج متقدمة ومبادرات إبداعية لضمان تحقيق ما يفوق توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين من حيث جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف بناء نموذج متكامل لخدمة العملاء. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع الخطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتنسيق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل أخصائي خدمة العملاء ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحسين وتطوير تجربة العملاء بشكل مستمر.

4ce5f864f1425ee1.job_title: Technician Commercial Vehicles Al Futtaim Automotive FAMCO
4ce5f864f1425ee1.description: About the Role Al-Futtaim Automotive FAMCO is seeking a skilled and dedicated Service Technician to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves performing preventive maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs on commercial vehicles, ensuring adherence to manufacturer standards and company procedures. The successful candidate will contribute to maximizing vehicle uptime and delivering high-quality service. Key Responsibilities Perform preventive maintenance, breakdown repairs, and running repairs on commercial vehicles. Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and powertrain-related issues. Execute repairs involving clutch systems, brakes, aggregates, and other vehicle components. Ensure repairs are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with OEM standards. Identify additional repair opportunities and provide technical observations to improve vehicle performance. Utilize diagnostic tools, workshop equipment, and special service tools safely and effectively. Maintain accurate technical reports and identify root causes of vehicle concerns. Follow workshop safety standards, ISO requirements, and company procedures. Support and guide junior technicians to ensure quality workmanship and adherence to repair standards. Participate in continuous learning and technical training programs to enhance product knowledge and technical expertise. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in commercial vehicle maintenance, diagnostics, and repair. Demonstrated ability to achieve high productivity, efficiency, and quality standards. Strong experience in commercial vehicle maintenance, diagnostics, and repair. Knowledge of diesel engines, common rail systems, powertrain, driveline, electrical systems, and air conditioning. Familiarity with OEM repair standards, SOPs, and workshop best practices. Willingness to travel and attend field breakdowns and on-site repairs when required. Required Skills Ability to diagnose faults and perform effective troubleshooting and repairs. Strong understanding of workshop tools, equipment, and diagnostic systems. Excellent attention to detail with a commitment to quality and first-time fix performance. Ability to work independently and efficiently under pressure. Strong communication and technical reporting skills. Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering excellent service. Continuous learning attitude and willingness to develop technical capabilities. Strong safety awareness and adherence to workshop standards and procedures. Commitment to workplace safety and continuous improvement. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the Al-Futtaim Automotive FAMCO service team. The role requires adherence to workshop safety standards and participation in ongoing technical training.

4cfe500f05ca8399.description: About the Role Abyatona Contracting & Development is seeking a Senior Procurement Specialist for Infrastructure & Building Projects. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves managing the procurement process for complex construction projects, ensuring timely and cost-effective acquisition of materials and services. Key Responsibilities Review project documents including RFPs, BOQs, technical specifications, drawings, and PRs to analyze item descriptions, quantities, and requirements. Identify and clarify discrepancies or missing information with the technical department to define a clear procurement scope. Handle procurement for infrastructure materials (*, pipes, pumps, road materials, cables) and building materials (*, steel, concrete, finishes, MEP systems). Identify original manufacturers, authorized distributors, and evaluate suppliers based on technical capabilities, production capacity, delivery reliability, and quality. Prepare and issue RFQs, conduct detailed technical and commercial evaluations, and recommend purchases based on best overall value. Negotiate commercial terms including prices, discounts, delivery schedules, and payment terms, ensuring alignment with company policy. Manage technical approvals for samples, catalogues, and material submittals, ensuring consistency with final quotations and purchase orders. Monitor manufacturing and delivery progress, coordinate with site teams for receipt verification, and resolve any shortages or non-compliant materials. Match purchase orders, goods receipt records, and invoices for payment processing and maintain comprehensive procurement records. Prepare periodic reports on procurement status, financial commitments, savings, and supplier performance. Performance Indicators Accuracy and completeness of purchase orders and quotation evaluations. Adherence to project delivery dates. Reduction in material non-conformities and shortages. Documented cost savings while maintaining quality and specifications. Timely closure of approvals, outstanding issues, and supplier claims. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in procurement, specifically within infrastructure and building projects. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex project documents and identify procurement requirements. Strong negotiation skills and experience in managing supplier relationships. Proficiency in preparing detailed technical and commercial comparisons. Ability to manage multiple procurement processes concurrently and align with project schedules. Recruitment Assessment Candidates may be assessed on their ability to prepare a comprehensive comparison and purchase recommendation based on a provided Bill of Quantities (BOQ) item, specifications, drawing, and multiple supplier quotations. This includes identifying missing information, calculating complete costs, verifying lead times, payment terms, and warranties, and justifying the recommended supplier. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

4c3ad007944a1862.description: Job Purpose To lead the store team in delivering exceptional Patchi guest experience and achieving sales and profitability objectives. The Store Manager is accountable for daily operations, team performance, inventory accuracy, cash controls, premium presentation, and product quality, hygiene and food safety across chocolate, cakes, Merry Cream products and beverages, where applicable. Key Responsibilities Guest Experience and Commercial Performance Lead by example welcoming guests, identifying their needs, presenting products and delivering the approved Patchi customer journey. Achieve store sales targets and monitor footfall, conversion rate, average ticket value (ATV), units per transaction (UPT) and category sales performance. Review daily, weekly and monthly results, identify performance gaps and implement action plans with clear owners and follow-up dates. Conduct daily team briefings covering targets, product priorities, guest service, stock availability and selling opportunities. Coach the team on product storytelling, consultative selling, upselling and cross-selling; ensure promotions and competitions follow company guidelines. Resolve guest complaints within delegated authority, follow up on service recovery and escalate recurring or serious concerns. Oversee special orders, gifting requests and collection or delivery arrangements to ensure accuracy and timely fulfillment. Team Leadership and Development Allocate duties and prepare staff schedules in line with approved staffing plans, trading patterns and business needs. Monitor attendance, punctuality, grooming and conduct; maintain accurate records and coordinate exceptions with HR and the reporting manager. Onboard new employees and ensure completion of product, service, food safety, equipment and operational training and assessments. Observe performance, provide regular coaching and feedback, conduct appraisals and follow up on agreed development actions. Build a respectful and accountable team environment, recognize strong performance and address concerns in coordination with HR. Store Operations and Brand Standards Ensure opening, closing, shift handover and daily operational checklists are completed accurately and on time. Maintain premium merchandising, approved displays, product availability, cleanliness and organized service and storage areas. Ensure readiness of chocolate counters, cake displays, Merry Cream and coffee service stations, and guest seating where applicable. Monitor equipment condition, arrange approved maintenance and escalate faults or service interruptions promptly. Coordinate with the relevant departments on replenishment, promotions, store requirements and operational issues. Submit accurate sales, staffing, stock and incident reports and complete actions arising from store visits and audits. Inventory Waste and Cash Controls Plan replenishment based on sales trends, seasonality, stock levels and shelf life to reduce shortages and excess stock. Verify receiving, transfers, stock counts and adjustments; investigate variances and escalate discrepancies according to procedure. Control product, packaging, ingredient and consumable waste; ensure wastage is recorded and corrective actions are followed up. Oversee POS accuracy, cash reconciliation, safe custody, cash handover and deposits according to company procedures. Ensure discounts, refunds, returns, exchanges and vouchers comply with policy and approval limits; investigate unusual transactions. Protect company assets and maintain accurate records; report suspected theft, cash shortages or control failures immediately. Food Safety Hygiene and Equipment Care Enforce personal hygiene, safe food handling, allergen communication and cross-contamination prevention using approved company guidance. Verify temperature, shelf life, batch and expiry dates, labeling and storage conditions; ensure FIFO/FEFO is applied as required. Ensure cleaning and sanitizing schedules are completed for surfaces, utensils, cake tools, Merry Cream machines and coffee machines where needed. Review cleaning, temperature, wastage and equipment records and correct incomplete checks or deviations promptly. Maintain inspection readiness and follow up on food safety, hygiene and municipality audit findings with the relevant departments. Compliance Safety and Accountability Ensure the team follows company policies, operating procedures, health and safety requirements and management instructions. Maintain store emergency readiness and report accidents, hazards, security incidents and serious guest or employee concerns promptly. Maintain confidentiality of employee, guest and company information and ensure records are handled appropriately. Complete other duties related to the role as assigned by management. Qualifications and Experience At least three four of retail or hospitality experience, including one year in a supervisory or store management role; premium chocolate, gifting or food service experience is an advantage. Experience leading teams, managing sales targets and interpreting store performance indicators. Working knowledge of POS systems, inventory controls, cash reconciliation and standard office reporting tools. Arabic speaker with good English language Knowledge of food safety and hygiene practices.

4caf0a3930389656.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking a Project Engineer Electrical (Substation) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the execution and supervision of 380kV substation projects, ensuring adherence to project specifications, SEC standards, and safety and quality requirements. The Project Engineer will be responsible for managing day-to-day site operations and coordinating various project aspects. Key Responsibilities Manage the day-to-day site execution of 380kV BSP/substation projects. Coordinate with engineering teams, construction personnel, subcontractors, and SEC representatives. Ensure all work is executed in accordance with approved drawings, method statements, and specifications. Monitor project progress, including manpower, materials, and site resources. 4caf215c2260aa0e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الجياد الطبية عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع الخطط العلاجية، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المريض وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها. تشخيص الحالات المرضية للفم والأسنان وإعداد خطة علاجية متكاملة مع برنامج زمني محدد. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها ومعالجة التهابات اللثة. إجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى ووصف العلاجات والأدوية اللازمة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. مهارة في إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة وجراحات الفم الصغرى. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بدوام كامل. يتم العمل ضمن فريق طبي متخصص يسعى لتقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق الجياد الطبية، يرجى تقديم طلب التوظيف عبر القنوات المتاحة.

Key Responsibilities Manage the full accounting function, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, accruals, reconciliations, payroll accounting, and monthly closing. Lead month-end and year-end closing processes, ensuring timely, accurate, and complete financial statements. Prepare and review management reports, financial statements, and reporting packs for leadership, investors, banks, auditors, and other stakeholders. Oversee the external audit process from end to end, including preparation of audit schedules, coordination with auditors, resolution of audit comments, and timely issuance of audited financial statements. Ensure compliance with all applicable Saudi laws and requirements, including tax, zakat, VAT, withholding tax, e-invoicing, accounting standards, and regulatory filings. Monitor receivables, payables, collections, supplier payments, working capital, and cash reporting. Build, manage, and develop the accounting and finance operations team as the company scales. Support ERP, accounting system, and finance automation initiatives. 4c091dacc34f0a1d.description: Job Summary We are seeking a professional, polished, and guest-focused Call Centre & Reservations Representative to join the team at The Groves in Riyadh. أدوات النظافة على طاقم التنظيف بشكل يومي). متابعة ترتيب المستودع وتوزيع العهد على الأخصائيين. متابعات طلبات الشراء وتوفيرها. متابعة قسم الإعلام (إعداد جداول لتصوير المستفيدين وتصوير جلساتهم وجمع وتسليمه للأخصائي الاجتماعي. الالتزام بالقوانين واللوائح والتعليمات المنظمة للعمل. جرد أصول الفرع والأثاث. متابعة رضا أولياء الأمور عن خدمة النقل. إعداد كشف حضور وغياب الأطفال. متابعة استئذان الأطفال واتباع الإجراءات اللازمة له. إعداد سجل استئذان الأطفال وتوثيقه. متابعة خدمة العاملات للأطفال. متابعة خروج الأطفال للباصات والنقل الخاص. تسجيل أرقام أولياء أمور الأطفال في الجوال الخاص بالمركز – تحديث. بسرعة. مهارات تنظيمية قوية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط والتعامل مع التحديات الميدانية. الخبرات العملية: يفضل سنة في مجال العمل. المهارات التقنية: إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج 4cfc90bf426a08ba.description: About The Role Müller's Solutions is looking for a senior SAP Supply Chain and Procurement consultant to own the Source-to-Pay and inventory management workstream on a S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation for a major trading group in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This is a broad, senior generalist role — you will be the single specialist covering procurement, supplier management, and core inventory processes across 4 legal entities. You will work primarily offshore, joining the client onsite in Riyadh for key Fit-to-Standard workshops, UAT, and go-live. You'll partner closely with the Finance and Integration workstreams, since procurement processes touch both heavily in this engagement. What You'll Own — Fit-to-Standard workshops covering procurement and inventory processes, translating client requirements into standard S/4HANA Cloud configuration. — End-to-end configuration of purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and goods receipt workflows. — Supplier master data setup, purchasing contracts, and supplier evaluation and performance monitoring. — Core inventory and stock management configuration across all 4 legal entities. — The integration design touchpoints between Procurement (MM) and Finance (FI), working closely with the Finance Lead. — Data migration scope for vendor master records and open purchase orders, in coordination with the Data Migration Consultant. — End-user training delivery for procurement and inventory users during the Deploy phase. — 5+ years of SAP MM / Supply Chain consulting experience, with at least one full-cycle implementation as lead consultant. — Hands-on configuration experience in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition procurement processes. — Strong, demonstrable knowledge of the full Source-to-Pay process — from requisition through invoice settlement. — Practical experience with basic warehouse and inventory management configuration. — Comfort working independently across a broad scope, without a large team of specialists to lean on. — Solid understanding of MM-FI integration points: goods receipt, invoice verification, accruals. Preferred — Prior project experience in the KSA market, with familiarity around local procurement and supplier practices. — Exposure to intercompany stock transfer and subcontracting processes. — Working knowledge of Arabic, written or spoken. — Experience in trading, distribution, or bulk commodities client environments.

4c57d7b5a92f058d.description: JASARA PMC is currently seeking an experienced Project Manager - External Works to join our dynamic team. This role focuses on managing the planning, design, and execution of external works encompassing civil general assets and landscape projects within our comprehensive social infrastructure programs supporting Vision 2030. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading multi-disciplinary teams to deliver high-quality external works projects on time, within budget, and meeting client standards and regulatory requirements. You will collaborate closely with clients, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure alignment with project objectives and seamless project delivery. Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Landscape Architecture, or related field. Minimum of 10 years experience in project management and delivery of heavy civil projects. Proven experience as a Project Manager managing external works including civil general assets and landscape projects. Strong knowledge of civil infrastructure, landscaping design, and construction processes. Experience managing multi-disciplinary project teams and coordinating with consultants and contractors. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage project budgets, schedules, and risks effectively. Familiarity with local codes, standards, and environmental regulations. Proven track record of delivering projects on time and within budget. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities under pressure. Project management certification (e.g., PMP) is highly desirable.

4c98f85e7a20b1ff.description: Our client is building infrastructure for sovereign AI, the kind of technology that shapes how nations, enterprises, and people experience intelligence. We need someone who can translate that into a social presence that actually lands. Not just someone who can schedule posts. Someone who gets it. What you'll own: Full ownership of client's social channels: strategy, content, cadence, and community across LinkedIn, X, and wherever the conversation is happening. Knowing what to post, when, and why. You follow the AI and tech news cycle closely and you know how to move fast when something matters. Building content that speaks to both Western tech audiences and the Middle East, two markets we operate in seriously, not as an afterthought Working with our comms, product, and exec team to turn complex ideas into content that's sharp, accessible, and true to who we are. Managing content calendars, coordinating assets, and keeping the pipeline moving, especially around launches, events, and announcements Tracking performance and being honest about what's working and what isn't. We make decisions based on data, not vibes Who are you? You live in the tech and AI space online, not just as a job, but because you're genuinely curious about it You understand the cultural nuances of both MENA and Western audiences and you know those aren't the same playbook You write well in English and Arabic fluency is a genuine plus, not a checkbox You have at least 4 to 6 years of social media experience, ideally in B2B tech, AI, or enterprise SaaS. You've done this before and you have the receipts You're comfortable with ambiguity and working across time zones. We're a distributed team and we move fast You're equally comfortable setting the strategy and executing on it. you take a brief and run with it Bonus points: Arabic fluency AI/ML literacy Enterprise SaaS background Experience with GCC markets Basic visual/content creation skills Startup or scale-up experience What working here looks like? Fully remote. You'll report to Chief Ethics Advisor and work closely day to day with Head of Communications. This is a role with real ownership and what you build will be seen. We're a small, serious team. We do expect you to show up with ideas, move quickly, and care about the work.

4cfb5d652c4e6697.description: مدة العقد: عمل مؤقت ساعات العمل: من 12:00 مساءً إلى 8:00 مساءً (تدريب عملي أثناء العمل OJT). من 8:00 صباحًا إلى 4:00 مساءً (تدريب نظري). الوصف الوظيفي: الغرض من الوظيفة: تخطيط وتقديم البرامج التدريبية بما يتوافق مع معايير الجودة وسياسات الأكاديمية، وتدريب المتدربين وفق مستوياتهم المختلفة مع دعم تقدمهم وتطوير مهاراتهم. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية: التعاون مع المديرين لتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. تقديم الدورات التدريبية وورش العمل والجلسات الفردية. إعداد المواد التدريبية مثل ملخصات الوحدات التدريبية والفيديوهات وغيرها. دعم وتوجيه الموظفين الجدد والإشراف عليهم. تطبيق المناهج التدريبية وتصميم وتنفيذ البرامج التدريبية. اختيار وحجز أماكن التدريب عند الحاجة. متابعة حضور المتدربين وسجلاتهم التدريبية. مراقبة أداء المتدربين ورفع التقارير المتعلقة بتقدمهم. الإشراف على التدريب العملي أثناء العمل (OJT). حفظ سجلات التقييم واستخدام أنظمة إدارة التعلم (LMS) لإدارة بيانات المتدربين. تقديم الدعم المستمر للمتدربين خلال فترة التدريب.
